content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD sediment transport and morphology module, entire file guarded by '# if defined (SEDIMENT)' (L54, closed L1676). MODULE SEDIMENT_MODULE (L56) supports non-cohesive and cohesive suspended load plus optional bedload and avalanching. SEDIMENT_INITIAL (L136-988) reads ~37 input.txt parameters via READ_STRING/READ_LOGICAL/READ_Float/READ_INTEGER with defaults (L153-776), prints a parameter summary to log unit 3 (L783-836), allocates and zeroes all work arrays (L845-925), derives non-cohesive parameters: Dstar (L935), Tau_cr=(Sdensity-1)*grav*D50*Shields_cr (L936), Tau_cr_bedload (L937), Nikuradse roughness k_s=2.5*D50 (L938), and settling velocity WS by formula when not given (L943-945, comment L940 notes 11/08/2023 multiply-to-minus correction of Babaks formula); optionally reads hard-bottom elevation Zs from Mask_s_File (L956-984; GetFile parallel L973, unit 1 serial L975-981). SEDIMENT_ADVECTION_DIFFUSION(ISTEP) (L990-1441) solves depth-integrated advection-diffusion for concentration: total depth H=Eta*Gamma3+Depth (L1006), Hpo=MAX(H,MinDepth) (L1009); advective face fluxes Scalx/Scaly built either first-order upwind when Sed_Scheme(1:3)=='Upw' (L1014-1064) or weighted upwind with Weight0=0.9/Weight1=0.1 (L1066-1117), with optional roller undertow transport added to P/Q (L1021, L1046); diffusion uses eddy diffusivity k2=5.93*(ustar_c2+ustar_c)*(Hpo(I-1,J)+Hpo(I,J))/4 with log-law friction velocity ustar_c=0.4*u_c/(-1+log(30*Hpo/k_s)) (L1129-1154 x, L1163-1192 y; propeller wash UpcTotal added under PROPELLER&&VESSEL L1129-1130); boundary fluxes zeroed by FLUX_SCALAR_BC (L1196); SSP Runge-Kutta stage update CHH=ALPHA(ISTEP)*CHH0+BETA(ISTEP)*(CHH+DT*R1) with R1=-div(Scal)+Pickup-D (L1206-1215), clipping negative CHH (L1217), CH=CHH/Hpo (L1219), optional C_limiter cap (L1222-1227). Source terms (L1239-1348): bed shear Tau_xy=0.16/(1+log(k_s/(30*Hpo)))**2*u_c**2 (L1255, rho_w removed per comment L1249; propeller adds UpcTotal**2 L1252-1253); cohesive pickup Pickup=E_coh*EXP(alpha_coh*SQRT(|Tau_xy-tau_cr_coh|)) softbed or E_coh*(Tau_xy/Tau_cr_coh-1) hardbed (L1260-1268); non-cohesive van-Rijn-type reference concentration c_b=0.015*((Tau_xy-Tau_cr)/Tau_cr)**1.5*Dstar**(-0.3) (L1287) with optional pickup reduction MIN(1,ReductionParameter/c_b) (L1288-1293), c_a=reduction*c_b*D50/(0.01*Hpo) (L1296), Pickup=MAX(0,c_a*WS) (L1297); bedload magnitude bedf=8*(Tau_xy-tau_cr_bedload)**1.5/grav/(Sdensity-1) directed along ATAN2(V,U) (L1310-1328); hard bottom suppresses pickup/bedload when Zb>=Zs-0.001 (L1336-1345). Deposition (L1355-1380): cohesive flocs settling WS=a_coh*Cb**n_coh/MAX(SMALL,(Cb**2+b_coh**2)**m_coh) with deposition probability Pd=1-Tau_xy/Tau_crd_coh (L1361-1364); non-cohesive Cao(2004) D=gamma_cao*CH*WS*(1-gamma_cao*CH)**2 with gamma_cao=MIN(2,(1-n_porosity)/CH) (L1367-1372). Time-averaging of C/P/D over Morph_interval (L1385-1401). Optional mass/momentum coupling terms DcX/DcY (concentration-gradient pressure), ExgX/ExgY (exchange momentum), MassSed (L1409-1437). FLUX_SCALAR_BC (L1443-1517) zeroes normal face fluxes at domain edges (MPI_PROC_NULL-guarded) and around masked cells. MORPHOLOGICAL_CHANGE (L1519-1670): accumulates TotalSuspendLoad from averaged P/D (L1534) and TotalBedLoad from bedflux divergence (L1536-1542), bed change Zb=-(TotalSuspendLoad+TotalBedLoad)/(1-n_porosity) positive-for-erosion (L1545-1546) capped by hard bottom Zs (L1548); avalanching every Aval_interval when local slope4 exceeds Tan_phi moves dh=0.5*(Depth diff)-0.5*Tan_phi*DX between steepest-descent neighbor pairs (L1554-1637); updates Depth=Depth_ini+Zb*Morph_factor (L1642), exchanges ghosts via PHI_COLL (L1645) and re-constructs face depths DepthX/DepthY by interior averaging and boundary extrapolation (L1649-1667).

verbatim_spans.text: !  SEDIMENT is a module to model sediment transport and morpho changes
! a correction for Babaks formula. replace multiply with minus 11/08/2023
! note rho_w is removed, also removed in tau_cr
!  suspended load, Babak set a reduction here, I made it optional fyshi 07/07/2023
! Jim suggested changing the if statement to make it logical, it wont affect result
! only take care positive slope, lower point, assume the only on point reaches

unresolved: Cross-line: k4 @L1177 uses ustar_c which is only computed inside the preceding x-direction diffusion loop (L1127-1132); in the y-direction loop (L1163-1192) ustar_c is never recomputed for the current (I,J), so k4 combines ustar_c4 for (I,J-1) with a stale ustar_c from the last x-loop iteration
Cross-line: cohesive deposition overwrites module-scope WS @L1362 each point using the flocs formula, destroying any user-input WS value read @L548 for subsequent use
Kappa1 (L737) and Kappa2 (L752) are read and logged but never used in any computation in this file

FILE_EXIST used @L959-960 without local declaration in SEDIMENT_INITIAL (L145-147) - must come from a USE'd module; likewise loop indices I,J in SEDIMENT_INITIAL (L977) and MORPHOLOGICAL_CHANGE (L1530) are not locally declared
